name: Anomalous Console Authentication
description: The AWS Management Console is the web login for the account. When someone signs in from a country the user has never used, skips MFA, fails several times, or hops across many IP addresses in minutes, that often means a stolen password or a man-in-the-middle kit capturing the session. The attacker is not exploiting an AWS bug; they are using the real login page with credentials they obtained elsewhere. A single odd login can be travel. The combination of unusual location, missing MFA, and a burst of failures is what makes this look like theft rather than a tired employee.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
